intro: This site is tested like a product. The repository is public, every change goes through a pull request, and the pipeline below runs on each one. Nothing is deployed unless the tests pass.

risks.coverage: A schema validates cv.json at build time, and unit tests check date order, the current role and newest-first ordering.

risks.risk: Page does not match the data
risks.coverage: End-to-end tests compare what is rendered with cv.json: roles, companies, certifications, dates.
Contract tests reject phone, birth date and address fields, and phone-like values, in the data and on the rendered page.
Tests assert the email and LinkedIn targets.
axe-core checks WCAG 2.1 A and AA in light and dark mode, plus landmarks, heading order and keyboard skip link.
The suite runs on Chromium, WebKit and an emulated Pixel 7, and checks there is no horizontal scrolling.
